links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy stability after 'Are you sure?' challenge and specialty framing
links.effect: Baseline accuracy fell from 51.8% to 42.2% after 'Are you sure?' (AcFR 32.8%); correct-to-incorrect transitions (n=544) exceeded incorrect-to-correct (n=198). Specialty prompts changed accuracy by -1.8 to +2.8 points.
links.quote: Across all neutral model-case pairs, baseline accuracy decreased from 51.8% to 42.2% after 'Are you sure?' (AcFR = 32.8%).

unlisted_practices: Report first-pass accuracy, harmful flips, and beneficial corrections when evaluating diagnostic LLMs
Test LLM sycophancy under conversational certainty challenges

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark measuring diagnostic instability and sycophancy (e.g., changes in accuracy following conversational challenge prompts) across multiple LLMs using clinical vignettes.
